identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-14] Implement PR Mutation And Foreground Watch

values.goal: Implement idempotent PR publication and bounded foreground waiting over the reviewed GitHub adapter.
values.required_outcome: durable intent idempotent readback cancellation and bounded canary is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: Mode-bound publication intents, issue/PR/comment mutation, operation markers, exact linkage readback, `pr publish`, `pr watch`, check/review/mergeability updates, signal cancellation, and optional explicitly authorized merge policy.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-14 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
